purpose: Detect changes to inputs of an existing stored TAC reset; no source/raw/row/axis/serializer authority

issuance.stage: actual parsed source after parser load fixups
actual load after first recompose/paginate materialization

paragraphInput: Tuple(body paragraph index, full Paragraph serde serialization), including nested serialized controls/text, raw input payloads, IDs, rows, widths, offsets and serialized HWPX Cell.dirty_flag. Child paragraphs are not separately observed.
excludedControlFields: existing Table/Equation raw_ctrl_seal and other model serde-skipped raw/cache/permission witnesses
contextInput: actual DocInfo definition payloads including unknown extra_records (not body text)
full SectionDef including page geometry and master-page inputs
body positions/control indices and complete structural ColumnDef definitions
contextExclusions: body/cell paragraph text outside local owner
conservativeLimits: unused DocInfo definition addition invalidates equality
dynamic supplemental/exact-font/shaping contexts use existing override
performance: Hash/serialization byte and depth limits are not a total CPU execution limit: structural controls are scanned once per context pass, and serde may scan string escapes before writing. Current local hashes are computed once per edited native run_section and consumed via a bool vector. Current contexts refresh in actual full/deferred pagination transactions; query-only styles reuse the last transaction vector.
openReview: official full source inventory must add every newly changed observation issuer/consumer file before final RESOURCE generation
privateResourceInventoryLimit: Private compiled RESOURCE and its unit cover the existing224 inventory, not all newly changed observer files. Per-file source byte witness is supplied separately. Final official integration must expand inventory and regenerate RESOURCE.
